facts.fact: Deputy Minister Andries Nel said Court Online, an integrated end-to-end digital case management solution, went live at the Eastern Cape Division of the High Court in Gqeberha on 16 July 2025.
Nel said the Gauteng Division of the High Court implemented an electronic case management and litigation system after a pilot that began in the third term of 2019.
facts.system: electronic case management and litigation system

facts.fact: Nel said Court Online, now live for the Eastern Cape High Court, is powered by Microsoft for e-filing and case management.

systems.platform: Microsoft (e-filing and case management), CaseLines (evidence handling)
systems.owner: Department of Justice and Constitutional Development
